description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for user-related actions in the Coocook application, including user registration, profile display, password recovery, and email verification.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::User
classes.description: Catalyst controller class handling user-related web actions such as registration, profile viewing, password recovery, and email verification.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load user object based on username parameter.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays user profile, including organizations and projects.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Displays registration form for new users.

methods.name: post_register
methods.description: Handles submission of registration form, creates new user, and sends verification email.

methods.name: post_recover
methods.description: Processes password recovery request, sends recovery email.

methods.name: reset_password
methods.description: Displays form to reset password using a token.

methods.name: post_reset_password
methods.description: Handles password reset submission, updates user password.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies user's email address using a token.
